name: next-steps-appcard
description: After each turn, suggests up to three next prompts in a card above the input: a What next? title row with a collapse toggle and a close button, and a small card per suggestion. Click a suggestion's label to put its prompt in the input box as a draft you can edit. Starts collapsed.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

startCollapsed.title: Start collapsed
startCollapsed.description: Show only the card's title row until you expand it. Once you expand or collapse a card, the session keeps your choice.
